applicability: Comparative hardware knowledge for the SO-101 follower. The exact servo variant, printed parts and camera module of the installed unit are not verified. Measured state and live calibration take precedence.
model_lineage: Open-hardware model published by TheRobotStudio (SO-ARM100 project, Apache-2.0). Geometry is the new-calibration follower model with the added wrist camera mount; joint zero is the middle of each joint's range.

servo.bus: one half-duplex serial bus through a USB serial adapter board
servo.gear_ratio_variants: Kits ship STS3215 variants with different gear ratios and supply voltages; which variant is installed per joint is not recorded here.

lerobot_driver.arm_norm_mode: degrees centred on the calibration midpoint when use_degrees is true, otherwise -100..100
lerobot_driver.gripper_norm_mode: 0..100 percent of the recorded calibration range
lerobot_driver.max_relative_target: Optional per-command goal clamp relative to the present position; disabled by default in the driver.

not_established: stall torque and continuous torque of the installed servos
gear backlash (simulation models assume about 0.5 degree)
sign and zero agreement between driver calibration and the URDF
